verified: Semafor reported, citing unnamed sources, that the Commerce Department added Megaspeed to its entity list on Monday, requiring licenses for US companies to sell chips to the company; the New York Times reported the same designation.
unconfirmed: No official Commerce Department notice or entity-list entry appears in the available reporting, and Business Insider described Commerce as "preparing to blacklist" Megaspeed, leaving the formal effective date and license terms unconfirmed.

verified: 据《纽约时报》和 Semafor 报道，美国商务部于周一将 Megaspeed 列入实体清单，此后美国公司若要向其出口 Nvidia 芯片等美国技术，须申请许可；美国司法部与商务部发布的联合声明确认，商务部工业与安全局（BIS）对 Megaspeed 展开调查，并于 2025 年 6 月在 Singaporean 执法部门配合下进行实地最终用途核查、约谈首席执行官 Alice Huang，Nvidia 则于 2025 年 6 月将 Megaspeed 列入其“禁售”名单。
unconfirmed: Semafor 的报道依据未具名消息源，商务部尚未公布正式清单条目，许可的具体范围与生效细则均不清楚；Business Insider 在几乎同一时间仍称商务部“准备”将其列入黑名单，这与“周一已列入”的说法在时点上不一致；Megaspeed 涉及芯片走私的指控目前仍属指控，未经裁定。

titles.en: Commerce reportedly adds Megaspeed to US entity list, Semafor says
titles.zh: 美国商务部将 Megaspeed 列入实体清单，Semafor 报道
